title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B2.6 (Peaked November 24, 2026 at 00:41 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 318 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)

We're looking pretty quiet right now. 🌎

A large dark coronal-hole region is visible near the middle of the Sun, while sunspot activity remains limited.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211/193/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
